tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, unselected chips, input fields, stepper bodies.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface, e.g. the target-face preview box.

tokens.name: surface-bar
tokens.usage: Sticky bottom action bar.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of surfaces and unselected chips. Light: 3.5:1 on surface, 3.2:1 on ground (control-border minimum).

tokens.name: border-soft
tokens.usage: Hairline dividing the sticky bar from content.

tokens.name: border-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed outline of 'Add …' buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary values, e.g. face type under the size, unselected segment labels.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Section labels (uppercase), captions, summaries. 7.6:1 on surface (dark), 6.2:1 (light).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button, selected chip/segment fill and border. White text on it is 5.3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-bright
tokens.usage: Accent as text or icon on grounds and surfaces: links, 'Use', icon tints, radio dots, 'Suggested' badge. Dark: bright mint; light: deep green (7.0:1 on surface).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of selected cards and of the suggestion/repeat cards.

tokens.name: accent-tint-border
tokens.usage: Border of accent-tint cards and badges.

tokens.name: accent-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Rounded square behind a leading icon in an accent-tint card.

tokens.name: radio-off
tokens.usage: Ring of an unselected radio indicator.

tokens.name: target-gold
tokens.usage: Target face rings 9–10. Data/illustration only, never UI state.

tokens.name: target-red
tokens.usage: Target face rings 7–8. Data only — do not use as an error colour next to faces.

tokens.name: target-blue
tokens.usage: Target face rings 5–6.

tokens.name: target-black
tokens.usage: Target face rings 3–4 and ring separators on light zones.

tokens.name: target-white
tokens.usage: Target face rings 1–2.

styles.name: value-lg
styles.usage: Headline value in a summary card, e.g. '40 cm'.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: Numeric chips such as arrows per end.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Chip labels, card titles, stepper values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sub-lines under a value, hints, badges (badges at 600).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside segmented controls; tight text stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a grid or row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label-to-control gap inside a section.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a form screen.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: tap-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the primary action button.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Chips, icon wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs, list cards, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature cards and the primary button.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, wrapping text chips, compact steppers.
